name: trustlayer
description: Autonomous financial firewall and policy gateway for Razorpay agentic commerce, SaaS seat reconciler, and virtual cards.

tools.name: propose_razorpay_payment
tools.description: Proposes an autonomous purchase, SaaS license seat renewal, or vendor payment on Razorpay with employee beneficiary metadata and single-use virtual cards.

tools.name: get_policy_limits
tools.description: Retrieves active spending limits, velocity caps, department profile, and approved vendor allowlists.

tools.name: get_merchant_catalog
tools.description: Retrieves the machine-readable e-commerce & SaaS catalog of verified merchants for AI Buyers.

tools.name: list_active_subscriptions
tools.description: Lists all active SaaS subscriptions, provisioned employee seats, monthly costs, and renewal dates.

tools.name: reconcile_zombie_seats
tools.description: Scans SaaS subscriptions to detect inactive/orphaned seats and calculate monthly cost savings prior to renewal.
